[26-11-27 13:52:53 utils.py:147] DEBUG - Enabled logging.
usage: app.py [-h] [-c INPUT_CSV] [-r] [-rti] [-L] [-G] [-hd HEADERS] tag

positional arguments:
  tag                   A tag for the session. Session will be reloaded, if
                        tag exists.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -c INPUT_CSV, --input_csv INPUT_CSV
                        Path to the csv to be processed.
  -r, --revision        Create a new session by updating a existing session
                        with a new csv file.
  -rti, --reload_type_inference
                        Reload the type inference results.
  -L, --list_stored_sessions
                        List the tags of stored sessions..
  -G, --generate_scoped_pattern_training_data
                        Generate training data out of description with
                        assigned scoped pattern.
  -hd HEADERS, --headers HEADERS
                        Header Definition of the form --header='{
                        "csv_id_header": "ID", "csv_desc_header":
                        "Description", "csv_formal_header":
                        "Hanfor_Formalization", "csv_type_header" : "Type"}',
                        must be valid json.
